text:
Noah: Quick sync — we need a final plan for the newsletter that carries the webinar invite + the launch blog on 'low-latency serving patterns'. Want to avoid cannibalizing product update opens. Thoughts?
Priya: Suggest splitting: core newsletter (product + blog) goes Day 1, dedicated webinar invite goes Day 3 to engaged segments only. keeps cadence light for broad list.
Ava: agree on split. For the Day 3 invite, propose a two-tier subject line: short for mobile, more descriptive for desktop. also we should add a sticky CTA to the top for trialers.
Luis: segmentation detail: create these cohorts — trialers_7d, engaged_30d (opened 2+ in 30d), inactive_90d. Send invite Day3 to trialers_7d + engaged_30d. Inactive_90d get a 'teaser' in Day 1 newsletter only.
Noah: good. what about APAC timing? last minute registrants tend to drop if it's 3am local.
Priya: APAC schedule: move APAC send to Day4 local morning with same creative. EU/NA keep Day3 local morning. ops-bot: noted — will schedule staggered windows per region.
Ava: creative checklist: 1) headline, 2) one-sentence value prop, 3) 2 CTAs (register + request demo), 4) short quote from early beta user, 5) calendar attachments (.ics) for registrants.
Noah: subject A/B test ideas? want to measure register rate and downstream demo conversions.
Luis: A) "Live: Scaling low-latency inference — join our lab" B) "How we cut tail latency — live demo + Q&A" C) "Webinar: Practical serving patterns for engineers" — run A/B/C across engaged_30d (randomized).
Priya: For trialers_7d, bias toward B (concrete benefit). 70/30 B vs pooled others. Track UTM_source=newsletter, utm_campaign=serving-launch-2026.
analytics-bot: Cohort sizing estimate: trialers_7d ~ 4.2k, engaged_30d ~ 6.8k, inactive_90d ~ 28k. Expected register rates: trialers 7%, engaged 3.2%, inactive 0.6%.
Ava: suppression rules: exclude anyone who unsubscribed, and suppress those who received a "priority outreach" email in last 7 days. Also exclude partnership lists.
Noah: inbound routing: registrants with company_email domain matching our enterprise list should get sales lead tag and route to SDR queue; all others go to marketing-nurture flow. Anything manual?
Luis: Add auto-tagging: "webinar-reg" and if domain in enterprise allowlist -> add "sales-hot". ops-bot: webhook to zapier/salesforce configured — mapping set to tag sales-hot when domain match.
Priya: Nurture drip after webinar: 3-email sequence over 14 days: Day+1 recording + TL;DR, Day+5 deep-dive blog + demo CTA, Day+14 special offer (trial extension). Copy owners: Priya, Ava.
Ava: also prep a short survey in the Day+1 email to capture intent (1-5 scale) and route high-intent (4-5) to sales. Add question: "Would you like a 1:1 demo?"
Noah: final approvals: product quote needed by EOD today, legal to review calendar invite language by tomorrow 11am PT. Priya will lock segments and send final audience CSV to ops by 9am PT tomorrow.
Luis: I'll run a quick spam-check on the HTML and subject lines once we have drafts.
analytics-bot: Campaign forecast: project ~620 total regs, ~90 demo requests (based on cohort weights).
Noah: Great work. I'll post the send matrix in the doc and tag everyone. Link to draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/serving-launch-newsletter-draft. Please add comments on the copy by noon PST.
ops-bot: Campaign "Serving Patterns Launch  Newsletter + Webinar" scheduled for 2026-03-10 15:00 UTC (staggering enabled).
Noah: :raised_hands: thanks team.
